ambiguity_flags.note: 'truth_store' is ambiguous across at least three governed concepts: (1) the Layer-2 architectural layer itself, (2) the 'snapshots' table (SNAPSHOTS_TABLE), and (3) the underlying observations store (OBSERVATIONS). This cross-concept ambiguity directly threatens snapshot-boundary semantics. A reader encountering 'truth_store' downstream cannot determine whether it refers to the architectural boundary, the snapshot metadata table, or the raw observation store — exactly the confusion the snapshot contract (CLAUDE.md Section 6) is designed to prevent.

'decision_layer' maps to LAYER_3 but its operational-sounding form conflicts with LAYER_3's planned-only status. After a rename, the forbidden claim 'Layer 3 is implemented' (CLAUDE.md Section 10) would equivalently become 'decision_layer is implemented' — same constraint applies, but the new term makes the violation harder to detect because '-layer' implies existence. Downstream governance steps that pattern-match strong claims would need updating to catch the new form.
